items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: And it was Sandy, Sandy and Albert and... Gordon. Gordon and Louis Macenthal and myself and Sal Franzel and Benny Legas.

ctx.x: You started with... You played with us a while.

Well, I was with them when they started because we came right out of the blue room. So Seymour wanted to keep Albert working, keep a couple of us working. And it was Sandy, Sandy and Albert and... Gordon. Gordon and Louis Macenthal and myself and Sal Franzel and Benny Legas.
